宗教/文化/古代传统

en: being part of the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time
ex: traditional dress/music/art/culture/dance
传统服饰/音乐/艺术/文化/舞蹈

zh: medical treatment that is based on the ancient beliefs and practices from a particular culture
en: medical treatment that is based on the ancient beliefs and practices from a particular culture
ex: a key ingredient in traditional medicine
传统医学中的关键成分

zh: 传统主义（认为传统习俗比现代思想对社会更重要）
en: the belief that customs and traditions are more important for a society than modern ideas
a person who prefers tradition to modern ideas or ways of doing things
ex: He was known for his traditionalist views.
他以传统主义观点而闻名。

en: according to the beliefs, customs or way of life of a particular group of people, that have not changed for a long time
ex: The festival is traditionally held in May.
这个节日按照传统是在五月份过的。

en: to say things about somebody that are unpleasant or not true

zh: a large square in central London. It was created in 1830-41 and named in honour of Lord Nelson's victory at the Battle of Trafalgar. In the centre of the square is Nelson's Column and on one side of it is the National Gallery. It is one of London's most popular tourist attractions. It is also a place where political protests and other demonstrations are often held and very large numbers of people gather there every year to celebrate New Year.

zh: （沿固定路线的）航行，行驶，飞行
en: the vehicles that are on a road at a particular time
ex: There's always a lot of traffic at this time of day.
每天这个时候总是有很多来往车辆。

zh: 道路安全措施，减缓机动车车速措施（如在马路设置凸面使车辆减速，保障行人及骑自行车者的安全）
en: ways of making roads safer, especially for people who are walking or riding bicycles, by building raised areas, etc. to make cars go more slowly
a place where two or more roads meet, forming a circle that all traffic must go around in the same direction

zh: a plastic object like a cone in shape and often red and white, or yellow in colour, used on roads to show where vehicles are not allowed to go, for example while repairs are being done
en: a plastic object like a cone in shape and often red and white, or yellow in colour, used on roads to show where vehicles are not allowed to go, for example while repairs are being done

zh: 安全岛（供行人避让车辆）
en: an area in the middle of a road where you can stand and wait for cars to go past until it is safe for you to cross
